The '''Rugosa system''' was located in the [[Sanbra sector/Legends|Sanbra sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="TEAOC" /> near the [[Balmorra Run/Legends|Balmorra Run]]. It contained the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Gash Rugosa]] and the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]]. Rugosa was used as a vacation spot by the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TCWEG" />
